append.detail: UPDATE 2026-11-14 (breakpoint storage, dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS): BlockNode (lib/entity-blocks/node-tree.ts) gains an optional, additive `responsive?: { tablet?, phone? }` of sparse content-field bags (desktop stays `content`). readResponsive / upgradeLayout / cleanNode / sanitizeNode (each device bag through the block's own field sanitizer) / the Yjs node map (lib/editor-crdt/node-ydoc.ts) carry it, and setNodeResponsive writes it. The document is already jsonb, so no SQL. A document without the field loads and upgrades byte-identical (tested, including the frozen corpus). lib/builder/node-responsive.ts translates between the inspector's per-device values and the node (nodeDeviceValues, withDeviceValues) and resolves content for a viewport (resolveNodeContent). The canvas demo block is now a real BlockNode edited through those. Public rendering is unchanged: no public renderer reads `responsive` (test). Still open: the canvas holds its node locally and is not wired to a draft row; the inspector is not in the website or Space builder shells; an override cannot store an empty string (sanitize drops it, so it inherits); container queries on blocks and the real-viewport touch check remain a manual browser gate.
